notes.title: neko.works Winter Sale Savings, Super Night Riders S1 News!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022398/af7fcc855472cdd62ac4ff666a23131b36ca4932.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone ːlyingcatː

All of my bundles, games & DLCs are heavily discounted for the Steam Winter Sale 2022 ːshokkuː

Light Fairytale Prologue Collector Edition (Episode 1 + 2 + DLCs):
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/21146

Super Night Riders Collector Edition (2016 + DLC):
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/4662

neko.works Soundtracks & Art Bundle (only the DLCs): ːdidjasaysomethingː
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29418

Super Night Riders S1's development is going well! Here are a few features that I've implemented recently:

[list][*] Cars ːshokkuː
[*] Various clothes for Alice. Playable Kuroko from the Light Fairytale series ːcucuteː
[*] 360 degrees camera with the Right Analog Stick.
[*] Top-down view.
[*] 4x view ahead compared to 2016.[/list]

Still planned for Q1 2023. Wishlist now to be notified on the release:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1836660

Light Fairytale Episode 3 is also available to wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2159170

Here are a few more screenshots for Super Night Riders S1.

Again, thanks for your patience a support ːletsgo_loveː
baka-neko / neko.works
